questions.question: The average weight of a family of five members (in kg) whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 65 kg and 38 kg is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Weights of family members (in kg) = 40, 49, 56, 65, 38

**Formula used:**

Average weight = dfrac{{Sum of weights}}{{Number of members}}

**Calculation:**

Sum of weights = 40 + 49 + 56 + 65 + 38

⇒ Sum of weights = 248 kg

Number of members = 5

Average weight = dfrac{248}{5}

⇒ Average weight = 49.6 kg

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 2 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Time (t) = 2 years

Rate of Interest (r) = 16% per year

**Formula used:**

SI = dfrac{P × r × t}{100}

Where, P = Principal amount

**Calculation:**

240 = dfrac{P × 16 × 2}{100}

⇒ 240 = dfrac{32P}{100}

⇒ (240 × 100)/(32) = P

⇒ P = 750

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4000 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of interest for 6 years = 3% × 6 = 18%

Simple Interest = 18% of Principal

⇒ Simple Interest = (18 ÷ 100) × 4000

⇒ Simple Interest = 18 × 40 = 720

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4000

Rate (R) = 3% p.a.

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (I) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3ac1942a675c734a86294696e061dd3e1da7e6431b7b669a06569a4de233ddb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ I = (4000 × 3 × 6) ÷ 100

⇒ I = 40 × 18

⇒ I = 720

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

The final amount after adding simple interest is given by A = P + I, which can also be written directly as A = P(1 + RT ÷ 100).

Simple vs Compound Interest

For the first year (when compounded annually), Simple Interest and Compound Interest are identical. From the second year onwards, Compound Interest is greater than Simple Interest for the same rate.

Time to Double Investment

Under Simple Interest, a sum of money doubles itself when the earned interest equals the principal. This always happens in Time = 100 ÷ R years.

questions.question: A person got an article at 22% discount, if he got no discount, then he had to pay ₹1,760 more. How much did he pay (in ₹) for the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A person got an article at 22% discount, if he got no discount, then he had to pay ₹1,760 more.

**Formula used:**

Let the marked price be M

Discount = 22%

Discounted price = 0.78M

**Calculation:**

M - 0.78M = 1760

⇒ 0.22M = 1760

⇒ M = 8000

Price paid after discount = 0.78 × 8000

⇒ Price paid = 6240

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**

questions.question: A solid spherical item is melted into the shape of a cylinder mounted by a cone having same radius. The diameters of the cylinder and sphere are 21 cm each. What is the height (in cm) of the cone if the height of the cylinder is 7 cm? Take \pi = \frac{22}{7}
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere = Diameter of the cylinder = 21 cm

Radius of the sphere and cylinder (r) = 21 ÷ 2 = 10.5 cm

Height of the cylinder = 7 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3) pi r³

Volume of cylinder = pi r² h

Volume of cone = (1)/(3) pi r² h

Since the sphere is melted into the cylinder and cone,

Volume of sphere = Volume of cylinder + Volume of cone

**Calculation:**

(4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 10.5³ = ((22)/(7) times 10.5² times 7) + ((1)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 10.5² times h)

⇒ (4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 1157.625 = (22)/(7) times 110.25 times 7 + (1)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 110.25 times h

⇒ (4)/(3) times 22 times 165.375 = 22 times 110.25 + 115.5 times h

⇒ 4851 = 2425.5 + 115.5 times h

⇒ 4851 - 2425.5 = 115.5h

⇒ h = (2425.5)/(115.5)

⇒ h = 21

∴ The height of the cone is 21 cm.

questions.question: 360 toffees are distributed among Pushkal, Quadir and Rustam in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. After distribution, Quadir gives 20% of his toffees to Pushkal and Rustam gives 25% of his toffees to Pushkal. What is the new ratio of toffees with Pushkal, Quadir and Rustam?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

360 toffees are distributed among Pushkal, Quadir, and Rustam in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4.

**Formula used:**

Ratio distribution: frac{{part}}{{total parts}} times {total toffees}

Percentage transfer: frac{{percentage}}{100} times {toffees}

**Calculation:**

Total parts = 2 + 3 + 4 = 9

Pushkal's initial toffees = (2)/(9) times 360 = 80

Quadir's initial toffees = (3)/(9) times 360 = 120

Rustam's initial toffees = (4)/(9) times 360 = 160

Quadir gives 20% of his toffees to Pushkal = (20)/(100) times 120 = 24

Rustam gives 25% of his toffees to Pushkal = (25)/(100) times 160 = 40

Pushkal's new toffees = 80 + 24 + 40 = 144

Quadir's new toffees = 120 - 24 = 96

Rustam's new toffees = 160 - 40 = 120

New ratio of toffees with Pushkal, Quadir, and Rustam = 144 : 96 : 120

To simplify, divide each term by their HCF (24):

⇒ (144)/(24) : (96)/(24) : (120)/(24)

⇒ 6 : 4 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: A car travels 80 km at the speed of 20 km/h and the next 30 km at the speed of 30 km/h. What is its average speed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A car travels 80 km at the speed of 20 km/h and the next 30 km at the speed of 30 km/h.

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

**Calculation:**

Total Distance = 80 km + 30 km = 110 km

Time taken for first part = Distance / Speed = 80 km / 20 km/h = 4 hours

Time taken for second part = Distance / Speed = 30 km / 30 km/h = 1 hour

Total Time = 4 hours + 1 hour = 5 hours

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 110 km / 5 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 22 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: Reena sells an article at 12% below its cost price. Had she sold it for ₹540 more, she would have gained 15%. At what price should she sell the article to gain 20%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Reena sells an article at 12% below its cost price. Had she sold it for ₹540 more, she would have gained 15%.

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + Profit

Profit% = dfrac{Profit}{CP} times 100

**Calculations:**

Let CP = x

SP at 12% loss = x - 0.12x = 0.88x

SP at 15% profit = x + 0.15x = 1.15x

Given, 1.15x = 0.88x + 540

⇒ 0.27x = 540

⇒ x = 2000

To gain 20%, SP should be: 2000 + 0.20 × 2000

⇒ SP = 2000 + 400 = 2400

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
